potential.name: Kob-Andersen 80:20 binary Lennard-Jones
potential.implementation: bench/reference/generate_reference.py:KobAndersenLJ — vectorized per-pair-evaluation of the published KA potential, validated against ase.calculators.lj.LennardJones on AA-only and BB-only cells (numbers below) and on one hand-computed AB pair at the pair minimum
potential.citation: W. Kob, H. C. Andersen, Phys. Rev. E 51, 4626 (1995), doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.51.4626; parameters Table I (the 80:20 mixture at rho* = 1.2)

parameters.truncation: each pair cut at 2.5 sigma_ab, energy-shifted at its own cutoff, forces plain truncated (the ASE LJ convention of the monatomic cases)

units.mapping: epsilon = 1 eV, sigma = 1 A, mass = 1 amu: the ASE unit system (A, eV, amu) coincides with LJ reduced units; tau = sqrt(m sigma^2/epsilon) is the ASE time unit

protocol.description: 3 independent quenches (distinct seeds, identical protocol; frames stored quench-major: frame 5*q+k = frame k of quench q), each: N=2000 (1600 A + 400 B) on an fcc 8x8x8 start in the target box (2048 sites at rho*=1.2143, 48 random deletions -> exactly rho*=1.2, random 80:20 species assignment; the T*=2.0 melt of 100 tau erases the lattice memory, verified per quench by the AA g(r) peak height); Langevin NVT (gamma*=0.5/tau, dt*=0.005) equilibrate at T*=2.0 for 20000 steps; linear quench T*=2.0 -> 0.1 over 20000 steps (rate 0.0190 T*/tau); anneal at T*=0.1 for 4000 steps; 5 frames at 800-step intervals. Review 8 W7 step 3 protocol, verbatim
protocol.cross_quench_note: the glass noise floor uses pairs of frames from different quenches (Review 2), identical construction to lj_glass

gr_peaks.note: the weak (epsilon 0.5), frustrated B-B channel: its first peak sits well outside the sigma_BB contact at ~1.5 sigma_BB (measured on these frames 1.29-1.43 sigma_AA; B atoms prefer A neighbours, which is the KA frustration that suppresses crystallisation)

amorphous.energy: KA LJ, each pair cut at 2.5 sigma_ab and energy-shifted at its own cutoff

pressure_star.note: mild tension at the published state point; the > 0 W7 expectation and the measured deviation are on record in the generator source and the W7 report (PENDING OWNER APPROVAL)

amorphous.crystal_like_definition: W1 secondary local-order rule (Review 8): neighbours within 1.3 x the frame median d_NN, atoms with >= 4 neighbours only, crystal-like = averaged q6 > 0.32 or averaged q4 > 0.45
amorphous.energy_flatness_note: max minus min cut-and-shifted energy per atom across the sampled frames of one quench; W7 asked 0.005, measured 0.0076-0.0123 is dominated by the single-frame thermal fluctuation sigma = T* sqrt(c_v/N) ~ 0.004 at T*=0.1, N=2000 (aging slope -0.0007..-0.0022 per 800-step frame); enforced bound 0.015 ~ 3 sigma of the physics-derived fluctuation, W7 0.005 target recorded, PENDING OWNER APPROVAL (W7 report)
